packageRules.description: Grouped weekly Rust crate updates, one PR so the CI matrix runs once (PG-E0-17).
Grouped weekly frontend updates. A major needs a CI pass plus a visual regression run (DEPENDENCIES §1).
Pinned exactly by policy (DEPENDENCIES §1). Renovate may propose a new pin, but not a range.
GitHub Actions are grouped separately so a broken action does not block crate updates.
